skill_name: Describe how current politics could affect the economy of the United States
workflow: Current political tensions both domestically and internationally could have a serious impact on the US economy. On a domestic level, the policies of the current presidential administration could lead to increased costs for business and labor, higher taxes and tariffs, and more regulation. On an international level, continued instability in the Middle East and Asia could lead to higher energy prices, further eroding consumer and business confidence.
